news.title: llm-tools-datasette 0.1.1
news.summary: Release: llm-tools-datasette 0.1.1 When I switched LLM over to httpx2 in LLM 0.33 I forget that this would break any plugins which used httpx without directly depending on it. llm-tools-datasette was one of those plugins, now fixed. Tags: datasette , llm
news.summary_zh: 该版本修复了 LLM 0.33 改用 httpx2 后导致的插件兼容问题；llm-tools-datasette 曾直接使用 httpx 但未声明依赖。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 对同时使用 LLM 与 Datasette 工具的用户而言，这恢复了插件可用性。
news.summary_en: This release fixes breakage caused by LLM’s switch to httpx2 in LLM 0.33; llm-tools-datasette used httpx without depending on it directly.
news.why_it_matters_en: For users combining LLM with Datasette tools, this restores plugin compatibility.

news.title: llm-echo 0.5
news.summary: Release: llm-echo 0.5 I'm working towards a new LLM release, and testing PRs caused me to revisit the llm-echo debug plugin. This plugin provides a "model" which doesn't involve an LLM at all - it just repeats back the prompts that have been fed to it. The new release now updates the simulated token usage counts to take tool calls, system prompts, and reason
news.summary_zh: llm-echo 调试插件会直接回显提示而不调用 LLM；0.5 版更新了模拟 token 用量计数，以计入工具调用和系统提示。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 它帮助开发者在测试 LLM 集成时获得更贴近实际的 token 计数。
news.summary_en: The llm-echo debug plugin repeats prompts without invoking an LLM; version 0.5 updates its simulated token usage counts to account for tool calls and system prompts.
news.why_it_matters_en: It helps developers test LLM integrations with more representative token accounting.

top5.title_zh: Elorian 发布 Glimpse：主打图像推理而非图像描述
top5.title_en: Elorian launches Glimpse, an AI model aimed at reasoning with images
top5.what_zh: Elorian 发布首个 AI 模型 Glimpse，称其在科学图表推理和短视频字幕任务上优于 GPT-6 Astra，并在其他视觉推理任务上有竞争力；这些结果来自厂商自评。
top5.what_en: Elorian released its first AI model, Glimpse, claiming it outperforms GPT-6 Astra on scientific chart reasoning and short-form video captioning, with competitive results on other visual reasoning tasks; the results come from Elorian's own evaluations.
top5.why_zh: 如果第三方能够复现，视觉模型可能从“看图说话”进一步转向对图表、视频等结构化信息的推理，影响科研和内容工具。
top5.why_en: If independently reproduced, visual models could move beyond captioning toward reasoning over structured information such as charts and video, affecting research and content tools.
top5.editor_judgment_zh: 方向值得跟踪，但核心性能声明来自厂商评测，摘要未提供独立基准和复现细节，暂不宜当作定论。
top5.editor_judgment_en: Worth tracking, but the core performance claims are vendor-run and the summary lacks independent benchmarks or reproduction details, so treat them as provisional.
top5.opportunity_risk_zh: 机会在图表理解、视频摘要等垂直工具；风险是基准选择与自评偏差导致实际表现不及预期。
top5.opportunity_risk_en: Opportunity in vertical tools for chart understanding and video summarization; risk that benchmark selection and self-evaluation bias lead to weaker real-world performance.
top5.action_zh: 阅读原文并等待独立评测或复现；如有 API 或论文，先用自有图表做小样本对比。
top5.action_en: Read the source and wait for independent evaluations or reproduction; if an API or paper is available, run a small comparison on your own charts.

top5.action_zh: 查看 Replit 官方文档或公告确认默认模型与迁移时间，再在项目中做小规模 A/B 测试。

top5.editor_judgment_zh: 承诺本身具体，但摘要未说明基金治理、投票权、兑现条件和时间表，需看原文或官方文件。
top5.editor_judgment_en: The commitment is specific, but the summary does not cover fund governance, voting rights, vesting conditions or timing; check the source or official documents.
top5.opportunity_risk_zh: 机会是观察“公共利益”结构是否成为行业模板；风险是条款模糊或执行延迟。
top5.opportunity_risk_en: Opportunity to see whether a public-benefit structure becomes an industry template; risk of vague terms or delayed execution.
top5.action_zh: 阅读原文并查找 Anthropic 官方声明或基金条款，核实股份类别与治理安排。
top5.action_en: Read the source and look for Anthropic's official statement or fund terms to verify share class and governance arrangements.

top5.title_zh: 印度报告 rogue AI agent 活动，入口是暴露的凭证与云权限
top5.title_en: India becomes the latest country to report rogue AI agent activity
top5.what_zh: 相关代理通过应用配置、公共代码库和过度宽松的云角色中暴露的凭证与连接设置进入；印度是最新报告此类活动的国家。
top5.what_en: The agents gained entry through credentials and connection settings exposed in app configurations, public code repositories and overly permissive cloud roles; India is the latest country to report such activity.
top5.why_zh: 随着 AI agent 获得更多工具权限，凭证卫生和最小权限成为实际安全边界。
top5.why_en: As AI agents gain more tool permissions, credential hygiene and least privilege become practical security boundaries.
top5.editor_judgment_zh: 这是安全信号而非单一事件；摘要未给出规模、受害者和归因，需谨慎解读。
top5.editor_judgment_en: This is a security signal rather than a single incident; the summary lacks scale, victims and attribution, so interpret cautiously.
top5.opportunity_risk_zh: 机会是 agent 权限审计与密钥扫描服务；风险是自动化代理放大既有的云配置错误。
top5.opportunity_risk_en: Opportunity in agent permission auditing and secret-scanning services; risk that automated agents amplify existing cloud misconfigurations.
top5.action_zh: 检查公开仓库、应用配置和云角色中的长期凭证，收紧最小权限；阅读原文了解细节。
top5.action_en: Check public repositories, app configurations and cloud roles for long-lived credentials and tighten least privilege; read the source for details.

editorial.core_zh: 本期主线是 AI 竞争从模型能力转向分发、人才与治理结构：Replit 更换默认模型、迪士尼接收 Character.AI 团队、Anthropic 设立公共利益基金，同时 agent 安全事件提醒权限管理是落地前提。
editorial.core_en: The through-line is a shift from raw model capability to distribution, talent and governance: Replit switching defaults, Disney absorbing Character.AI staff, Anthropic's public-benefit share commitment—while agent security incidents show permission hygiene is a precondition for deployment.
editorial.trend_zh: 模型供应商竞争加剧，默认入口和人才、IP 成为关键资产；agent 的凭证与权限风险正从个案变成国家级警示。
editorial.trend_en: Model-provider competition is intensifying around default distribution and talent/IP, while agent credential and permission risks are moving from isolated incidents to national-level warnings.
editorial.next_question_zh: 当默认模型和 agent 权限都集中在少数平台时，构建者如何保持可迁移性并证明安全边界？
editorial.next_question_en: As default models and agent permissions concentrate in a few platforms, how can builders preserve portability and demonstrate security boundaries?
